ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (dark) with high-intensity (white) pixels constituting less than 15% of the visible surface; highest contrast concentrated at the median notch and fluke tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniformly dark pigment across the majority of both lobes; high-contrast white mottle cluster localized in the lower-central region near the notch; high-intensity clusters localized at the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 55 degrees and significant vertical depth relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude jagged serrations visible on the distal half of the right lobe; the left lobe displays moderate-frequency, lower-amplitude undulations; central regions of both lobes are relatively smooth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal curve with initial convexity from the notch transitioning to sharp upward concavity (flare) toward the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-intensity circular pixel groups on the outer tips (likely barnacle colonization) and sparse circular spots scattered near the center-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregular tissue morphology and jagged protrusions on the distal edges, particularly the right lobe, indicating significant wear or parasitic encrustation.
other_distinctive_markers: Strongly asymmetric trailing edge serration pattern between the left and right lobes.
